messages.subject: pystan error--- distutils.errors.CompileError: command 'cc' failed with exit status 1
parts:
I run python in MacBook. I use the command "pip install pystan" to install the pystan and run the example1 eight schools from http://pystan.readthedocs.org/en/latest/getting_started.html. Then i get the following error.

INFO:pystan:COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL anon_model_95013624776d537c3cd7cd4d641c30e0 NOW.

Traceback (most recent call last):

  File "/Users/Xiaoran/Documents/JavaWorkShop/DesignForDoIt/ChaolicDynamics/SimpleExample.py", line 34, in <module>

    fit = pystan.stan(model_code=schools_code, data=schools_dat, iter=1000, chains=1)

  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan/api.py", line 368, in stan

    verbose=verbose)

  File "/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/site-packages/pystan/model.py", line 309, in __init__

    build_extension.run()

  File "/System/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/distutils/command/build_ext.py", line 337, in run

    self.build_extensions()

  File "/System/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/distutils/command/build_ext.py", line 446, in build_extensions

    self.build_extension(ext)

  File "/System/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/distutils/command/build_ext.py", line 496, in build_extension

    depends=ext.depends)

  File "/System/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/distutils/ccompiler.py", line 574, in compile

    self._compile(obj, src, ext, cc_args, extra_postargs, pp_opts)

  File "/System/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/2.7/lib/python2.7/distutils/unixccompiler.py", line 122, in _compile

    raise CompileError, msg

distutils.errors.CompileError: command 'cc' failed with exit status 1.


I have no idea what is wrong and what should i try next.

0) open a new terminal on El Capitan
1) brew install python
2) pip install pystan
3) the eight-schools example, runs fine.

This is with gcc 5.2.0 installed via brew.  Might be worth checking if the terminal gives you better results just to isolate the issue.

So is it as simple as

0) open a new terminal on El Capitan
1) brew install python
You have to install brew first: http://brew.sh/
2) brew install gcc  # or download Xcode for free from the App store

Brew gives you a choice of gcc's I got 5.2 as a dependency when I installed R and that seems to be what CmdStan finds, but Pystan finds the clang from XCode... so you just need to get your hands on some compiler.  I'm not sure how the find-a-compiler mechanism is working...

3) pip install pystan
4) the eight-schools example, runs fine.

I installed a lot of other stuff via brew when I set up this machine but pystan was pleasantly easy. 

Krzysztof
